card.name: Degree words like most, fully, nearly
card.fires_on: Degree or extent words such as most, full, fully, nearly and twice, placed before an adjective, noun or verb phrase. Also the leading 0 in a lab reference range.

modes.label: Degree adverbs
modes.description: Words like most, fully, nearly or twice that say how much or how far, right before the word they modify.
modes.example: The notes of this species differ considerably from those of the House Wren, to which it is<< nearly>> allied.

modes.label: Full before a noun
modes.description: The word full used as a modifier before a noun such as agonists or use.
modes.example: making the respiratory effects of buprenorphine appear similar to those of<< full>> opioid agonists.

modes.label: Start of a range
modes.description: A leading zero at the start of a lab reference range.
